name: Her Wild Ways
overview: Hao Yun, a young woman from impoverished Yiyun Village—where women are known for bearing multiple children at once—is sent to the city to lift her village out of poverty. There, she crosses paths with the powerful Li family, rumored to be cursed: any woman who gives them an heir is doomed to die. Tempted by a life-changing reward, Hao Yun agrees to marry the aloof and childless CEO Li Shaoting.
